---
# Negative control for the render-check table guard. Not an example: this
# poster exists to fail the grep that every other poster must pass. It lives
# outside examples/ for that reason, and is listed in .quartoignore so it does
# not ship with the extension.
#
# `table-css: keep` leaves the CSS below intact, so Quarto's Typst writer
# emits the absolute size the guard looks for. If rendering this stops
# producing a hit, the guard has stopped working and the posters passing it
# are proving nothing — which is how a guard that never matched gt shipped
# green once already.
#
# The `font-family` matters as much as the size: gt writes the font list
# first, so the emission is `set text(font: (...), size: 12pt);table(` and a
# pattern anchored on `size:` following `set text(` misses it.
title: "Table guard fixture"
format:
  sciposter-typst:
    poster:
      size: a1
      columns: 1
      table-css: keep
---

```{=html}
<table style="font-family: Roboto, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12px;">
<thead><tr><th>Gear</th><th>Sets</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Gill net</td><td>48</td></tr>
<tr><td>Trap net</td><td>31</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
```
